note: Primitive state campground on US-3 in the Connecticut Lakes State Forest between Second and Third Connecticut lakes, five miles below the Canadian border, on the stretch of road known as Moose Alley. Only sites 11 and 12 take a rig (24 and 25 ft); the rest are tent, pop-up and platform sites. Payment at the campground is cash or traveler's checks only (2017 policy sheet). --Claude
summary: Park page + 2017 info sheet and map + 2026 schedule + full RA catalog: 25 primitive sites, only 11 and 12 take 23 ft+ (24 / 25 ft); $29; pit toilets and water, no showers or hookups; Memorial Day weekend to Columbus Day weekend.
